records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli
evidence: result:the plugin moved from 0.42.0 to 0.43.0 for scope user

result:the installed copy records gitCommitSha 18e30ad4aaebbbc8c261b26a3d063a5d304d68e0 -- the v0.43.0 tag commit -- and its hooks/module_stage.py carries this release's NO_TODO_MARKER and plan_without_todo

records.subject: spec-guard-claude-code-cli-hook
evidence: command:PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin claude -p '只复述你收到的 spec-guard 注入里「当前阶段」那一行和所有以 "- " 开头的行，逐字，不要加别的' --max-turns 2
result:exit 0; the reply was `当前阶段: **BUILDING**`, `Current module: work-mod`, `Modules 2 · Specs 2 · Plans 2 · In progress 1 · Done 1`, and no `Plan without todo` line

host:a disposable Git project whose CLAUDE.md wraps the installed copy's templates/claude-block-local.md in the BEGIN/END convention markers; module done-mod has only a plan.md carrying `<!-- spec-guard: no-todo -->`, module work-mod has one unchecked todo item
result:the declared module still counts as done (Done 1) and is no longer counted as plan-without-todo -- the behaviour this release adds
limit:the first attempt omitted the BEGIN/END markers, so the hook stayed silent as designed for an unactivated project; that was a fixture error, not a product result
host:PATH was restricted so python3 resolved to /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6, the macOS system interpreter
